title: A short question with nothing to trim
note: Here on purpose: there is nothing worth removing, so the honest result is 0% saved. It deliberately does NOT declare anyray_retrieve: this harness sends one request and cannot answer a tool call, so claiming retrieval it cannot honour makes the optimizer elide spans nothing will fetch back. The saving here is therefore what a NON-retrieval client gets — a retrieval-capable agent sees more.
